sloka: ननु सद्यो अविनीतस्य दृश्यते कर्मणः फलम् ।कालो अपि अंगी भवति अत्र सस्यानाम् इव पक्तये ॥३-४९-२७॥
transliteration: nanu sadyo avinītasya dṛśyate karmaṇaḥ phalam ।kālo api aṁgī bhavati atra sasyānām iva paktaye ॥3-49-27॥

translations.english: The effect of arrogant action cannot be seen right away. Just as the crop yields results only after ripening, in the same way it takes time. Time acts as a supporting factor.
